sections.p: Account data (name, email address), content you publish (listings, job offers, messages, reports) and technical data required to run the site.

Measurement tools (PostHog, Vercel Analytics) are only enabled after you agree. You can refuse or change your choice at any time with “Manage cookies” in the footer. If you refuse, no optional event is sent.
You can request access to, correction of or deletion of your data by writing to us through the Contact page.
Hallomada is an exchange and mutual-support platform for the Malagasy community in Germany.
You are responsible for what you publish. Unlawful, misleading or abusive content can be reported and removed.
Hallomada does not verify every listing and is not a party to exchanges between users. Stay vigilant and never send money before verifying an offer.
Accounts that do not follow these rules may be restricted or suspended.
